name: Nyo-Manji
source:
Tokyo a century ago.
Private detective Kudo Mauna is a famous expert in paranormal activities. Together with the legendary witchcraft "Masashi" user high school girl Ririmori Komori they accept a case request. One woman starts to feel abnormal activity inside her body. But the incident turns in an unexpected direction..

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个世纪前的东京。
私家侦探工藤莫纳是著名的超自然现象专家。与传说中的巫术“Masashi”使用者高中女生Ririmori Komori一起接受案件委托。一名女性开始感觉到体内有异常活动。但事态却朝着意想不到的方向发展……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
